#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [ -d src ]; then
    missing=0
    while IFS= read -r srcdir; do
        rel="${srcdir#src/}"
        testdir="tests/$rel"
        if [ ! -d "$testdir" ]; then
            echo "Missing test directory for source: $srcdir"
            missing=1
        fi
    done < <(find src -type d)
    if [ "$missing" -ne 0 ]; then
        exit 1
    fi
fi
exit 0
